scenarios.pins: everything but routing is bound: a blocking-only re-ask keeps the answer; A -> B -> A clears it, and a delayed answer to A (signed before B, based_on the head it reviewed) is then accepted

steps.note: sev1 adds sev's phone sevp1, certified for look and decide only
Q1 asked (content A)
the phone answers A
re-ask with only blocking changed (routing): same hash, the answer stands
Q2 asked (content A)
Q2 re-asked (content B)
Q2 re-asked (content A again)
the delayed answer to A arrives: based_on the earlier reviewed head; accepted (F1 semantics)
